purpose: Bounded model evaluation and retraining. Dataset scores do not establish broad real-world or clinical performance.

weather.method: 2000 seeded bootstrap resamples of whole duplicate/patient groups
weather.split: Exact and conservatively grouped near-duplicate images kept separate
weather.limit: One small weather collection; grouping is conservative and unfamiliar photo sources remain untested.

oct.method: 2000 seeded bootstrap resamples of whole duplicate/patient groups
oct.split: Patient IDs and exact hashes kept separate
oct.limit: Balanced subset of one OCT collection; no clinical validation. Legacy test was contaminated.

parking.split: Contiguous filename-prefix blocks with gaps between partitions
parking.limit: Camera and site identifiers are unavailable. This is not an unseen-camera benchmark.

alpaca.split: Original held-out test images; development uses a separate grouped split
alpaca.limit: One small single-class collection; generalization and negative-image coverage remain limited.

tiger.limit: A new 12-keypoint tiger prototype from one video. Landmark precision is limited (see stricter mAP50–95); this is not the missing 39-keypoint model or a general animal model.
